title: TORX® 2026 – Event schedule
claims: Bib distribution, TOR bag deposit, the pasta party and the briefing for TOR330 take place at the Courmayeur Forum Sport Center on 11–13 September 2026.
Both TOR330 starts are on Viale Monte Bianco in Courmayeur, at 10:00 and 12:00 on 13 September 2026.
First arrivals and the finish area are at Jardin de l'Ange in Courmayeur.
The TOR330, TOR450 and TOR30 last finishers are expected at 18:00 on 19 September 2026.
The awards ceremony is at 11:00 on 20 September 2026 at Parco Bollino.
